title: Ritual of Resonance
text: Requires one Ritual Energy Core, eight Crystal Pedestals and eight Resonance Cores. Use a Spacetime Knot on the core to consume the knot and eight offerings, producing one terminal. The ritual core and pedestals remain.

Sneak-use a resonance node to link or unlink; use the reusable terminal to select a container. Only its owner may access links, including across dimensions. Advanced condensation raises the four-link limit to six and preserves existing links.

Opening an interface costs half your maximum mana, ignoring reductions. Failed attempts and transfers are free. Containers without an interface cannot be opened; removing a node or container ends access.
Link a Marisa Crystal Ball to open its shop remotely. Its node changes from pale red to yellow. Opening costs the same; stock and purchase limits are shared with direct visits.
